title: Vibrant Blanch Korean mushroom Sujjuk Jjigae
description: A fresh, pillowy, brunch-mood Korean dish featuring mushrooms, blanched to perfection. Nut-free friendly and with a tangy flavor.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add Korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add toasted sesame oil, soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
Add 100ml water to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions and toasted sesame seeds.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and serve immediately.
This dish is best served immediately and can be refrigerated for up to 1 day before reheating.
